chunks: From him, from Safwan, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Do not count the rak'ah in which you did not witness its takbir along with the Imam.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.تَشْهَدْ: to witness or be present for
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَتَهَا: its opening takbir connected to that rak'ah
key_terms.لَا تَعْتَدَّ: do not reckon or count as valid

ai.seo_question: When does a rak'ah count for someone joining the Imam in congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about joining congregational salat (prayer). It states that a rak'ah is not counted for the follower if he did not catch its takbir with the Imam, indicating the importance of properly joining the Imam in that unit.
